verdict.rationale: Clara documents an API reference with complete, runnable per-language code examples alongside it (clara-docs-25, clara-docs-27). It also publishes a live OpenAPI 3.1 schema that supports Postman import (clara-docs-2, clara-probe-3) and offers a sandbox for safe testing (clara-docs-8). The evidence never shows an in-browser interactive 'try it' console, so the interactive half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit interactive/try-it-in-browser API explorer, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
